# Responsible Disclosure

Jugalbandi currently targets local installation, not a deployed shared service. Report privately to the repository owner; do not include resume contents, API keys or exploit payloads in public issues. A dedicated private reporting channel has not yet been established; do not invent an address or promise a response time. The upstream policy below is retained for context.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Resume-Matcher strives to stay ahead of security vulnerabilities but would love to get the community's help in making us aware of the ones we miss.

Please contact a maintainer to report security vulnerabilities and exploits.

We will acknowledge legitimate reports and address them according to their severity.
